font-size:0 is also an inline-block spacing hack: a descendant restoring a non-zero size does render, so its text is kept

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<div style="font-size:0"><span style="font-size:14px">restored and visible</span></div>')
puts result.content.inspect
```
